title: Malicious code in @rizzkezik/bailseys (npm)
description: The @rizzkezik/bailseys npm package version 6.7.10 includes a dependency on libsignal sourced from an unpinned GitHub repository controlled by a third party. This allows arbitrary code execution during installation because the dependency is fetched directly from a mutable personal GitHub repository without version pinning or integrity verification. The malicious code can be substituted at any time by whoever controls the repository, posing a supply chain risk.
